_comment: CrossLight surveillance-device signatures. Copy this to /flock/signatures.json on the SD card. These entries are PLACEHOLDERS with example OUIs (00:00:00) that match nothing real -- fill in current fingerprints from your own research before relying on this. Fingerprints change; keep this file updated. OUIs may be written AA:BB:CC, AABBCC, or AA-BB-CC. A device matches a signature by ANY listed OUI or ANY listed ssid_contains substring (case-insensitive).

signatures.name: Example ALPR camera
signatures._note: Replace with verified values. ssid_contains is a hint only; a custom SSID will not match.
